card.title: For the Record
card.instruction: Get someone to state exactly what they did, knew, or authorized before you reveal your own involvement.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before I show you my dinner invitations, who did you authorize your sister to bring?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: A date. Did you invite my ex?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Did you name anyone she couldn't bring? Then we'll get to my list.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Yes. My ex. I sent you both the same message.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: What time did you send it to me? I'll put that beside my invitation's timestamp before we open it.
